title: Conductive material dispersed solution and lithium secondary battery prepared by using the same
abstract: In the present invention, a conductive material including a bundle-type carbon nanotubes; Dispersants; And it comprises a dispersion medium, when the frequency is 1Hz when measuring the rheometer provides a conductive material dispersion having a phase angle (3 ° to 18 °) and a lithium secondary battery prepared using the same. The conductive material dispersion has a high solid-like property, it is possible to form an electrode active material layer of uniform thickness without fear of collapse and crack generation during electrode production, and as a result can improve the performance characteristics, in particular capacity characteristics of the battery.
